title: FolderModel
description: Describes the properties of a secret folder

childFolders.description: List of folders within this folder

folderPath.description: The path of all folders and subfolders beginning at the root anterminating at this folder.

folderTypeId.description: The icon to display for the folder. Depricated in latest UI. Use 1 when setting this value.

inheritPermissions.description: Whether the folder should inherit permissions from its parent (default: true)

inheritSecretPolicy.description: Whether the folder should inherit the secret policy.  Defaults to true unless creating a root folder.

parentFolderId.description: The ID of this folder's parent folder.

secretPolicyId.description: The id of the Secret Policy that sets security and other settings on secrets contained within the folder.

secretTemplates.description: List of templates that may be used to create secrets in this folder

IFolderModel.description: Describes the properties of a secret folder

childFolders.description: List of folders within this folder

inheritPermissions.description: Whether the folder inherits permissions from its parent

inheritSecretPolicy.description: Whether the folder inherits the secret policy

secretTemplates.description: Secret templates associated with this folder

heartbeatEnabled.description: Is heartbeat enabled for this template

passwordTypeId.description: Password Type that the secret template uses for password change

passwordTypeReady.description: Is the template password type ready

secretCount.description: Number of Secrets associated to the template. Only populated when IncludeCount is set to true.
